race.description: Harry Coffey Swan Hill Jockey Of The Year 25/26 Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: MISS TRUSTFUL (7) produced a reasonable effort when fifth last start over 1700m at Geelong, beaten 2.5 lengths. That followed a win at Geelong the start prior. Ideally placed and is sure to prove tough to beat. QUEEN OF CORDOBA (10) finished fourth last start over 1600m at Bendigo after racing on the pace for much of the way. Has ability and a bold showing is expected in what looks a slightly easier race. EISHAA (8) finished out of the money two starts back then was beaten 10 lengths when ninth in a 1300m contest at Bendigo nine days ago. Ideally placed and is sure to play a major role. BRAZEN WARRIOR (3) exploded last start, when well-supported, to score a dominant maiden win and might be ready to really go on with it. NO GREATER VUE (4) doesn't win out of turn, scoring just once from 13 starts. Again tasted defeat last start when fifth over 1500m at Ballarat Synthetic, beaten 2 lengths, but rarely runs poorly and is a must of exotics.
